footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Celsius: after $44.2M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 85.5% to $2.5B in 2025. Gross margin was 50.4%, versus 50.2% a year earlier, and operating income fell 9.4% to $141M, a 5.6% margin.
Net income fell 40.6% to $63.8M, or $0.25 per share. Operating cash flow was $359M and free cash flow $323M, versus $240M; Celsius returned $5.7M through buybacks.
sources: Celsius Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
